svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: A band relaxing onto the path
svg.desc: Animation on a model energy surface: seven images start on a straight line between the reactant and product minima, relax onto the curved minimum-energy path, and the highest image then climbs to the saddle point.
